messages.subject: Project Harbor - Tindale Precision Coatings
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

We'd like to instruct you on a new acquisition - codename Project Harbor. The target is Tindale Precision Coatings, a thermal-spray coatings business in Coventry. Founder-owned, around £42m enterprise value. Can you get an NDA out to the company today so we can get into the data room? Engagement letter to follow.

Daniel
